Subject: Re: Follow-up: security/compliance details from today's call

Hi Samir / Priya — great speaking with you both. Per our call, summary + attachments and next steps below.

Quick answers up front:
- SOC 2: Redwood has a SOC 2 Type II report covering our hosted inference platform (period: Jan 2025 - Dec 2025). I've attached the report excerpt that covers production controls; the full report is shared under NDA/secure link — we'll provide that if needed.
- GDPR / HIPAA: We operate under documented data processing controls and a HIPAA-compliant configuration for customers who enable required controls. We do not generally process PHI unless customers opt into a dedicated/isolated deployment and configure necessary controls (we noted this during the demo).

Attachments I've included for your initial review:
1) Redwood_SOC2_Type2_Report_2025.pdf (redacted excerpts)
2) Vendor_Security_Questionnaire_Pharmaco.xlsx (blank questionnaire to fill)

Planned roadmap and scope items relevant to Pharmaco:
- SOC scope expansion: We are actively planning to expand SOC coverage to include Dedicated deployments and additional data plane controls; target window Q2 2027 (dependent on customer pilots and audit scheduling).
- ISO 27001: Roadmap item targeted H2 2027; currently under scoping and gap assessment with external assessor.
- FedRAMP: Longer-term initiative; no active timeline for FedRAMP certification today.

Next steps / asks:
- Please start with the questionnaire (attached). If you can return by 2026-10-21, procurement would be happy.
- Let us know any specific evidence requests and we'll route them to engineering/security for pickup.
- If you need the full SOC 2 Type II report, we can share via secure link/NDA — tell me what you prefer.

I've looped in Rishi (InfoSec) and Lauren (Sales Ops) to help with evidence and procurement coordination. Rishi / Lauren: can you confirm owners for evidence requests and an internal SLA for turnaround?

Regards,
Marissa Cole
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192
